text: Over the last 30 days, several visitors noted difficulties with signage and access, particularly for those needing handicap parking and shuttle service from the lot to the entrance. Some found the AI elements in the exhibits poorly executed or disappointing, and a few mentioned that many displayed items were replicas. There were also complaints about the need to purchase tickets in advance and timed entry causing delays or confusion. A small number of reviews raised concerns about limited food options and crowding during peak times.

windows.7: Visitors continue to raise concerns about accessibility, particularly the lack of clear signage for handicap parking and the distance from parking areas to the library entrance. Some found the use of AI in exhibits, especially the Rough Riders video, to be poorly executed and disappointing. Several reviews noted that many displayed items are replicas, which affected their experience. Positive comments focused on the building’s architecture and interactive exhibits, though a few mentioned issues with crowding and wait times. Overall, the average rating remains high, but attention to accessibility and exhibit authenticity could improve visitor satisfaction.

Several reviews criticized the AI elements in the exhibits as poorly executed or distorted, and some expressed disappointment that many displayed items are replicas. The timed-entry ticketing system caused frustration, especially for those unaware tickets must be purchased in advance, leading to delays and denied entry. Food options in the café were also mentioned as limited and unsatisfactory by some visitors. Despite these concerns, many found the architecture and interactive exhibits engaging, though wait times and crowd management affected overall experience.
